Grants linearly scaling benefits as the Magazine drops from 50% capacity to empty:
• 10 to 20 Range
• 30? to 50? Handling
• 10-20% decreased Handling Animation Duration
• ${5*#d}?% to ${10*#d}?% decreased Accuracy Cone Size

<special/>Special weapons only receive 50% of the benefits. Stats are rounded up.
